correctness.rationale: All rates/normalizations and quantifiers are explicit. The nine-component Lindblad generator is independently inverted to recover the exact positive-denominator rational T. The derivative polynomial has sign-certified coefficients in degrees 3..8, exact identities for degrees 0..2, and a strictly increasing critical cubic. Descartes rule plus endpoint signs proves exactly one simple positive stationary point above threshold and none below. The large-gradient scaled polynomial has the unique nonzero positive root at t=1 and an exact next-order coefficient. The standalone checker reproduces 83 symbolic and numerical assertions. No sampled root counts are used as a proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: The detuned path trimer is the smallest nontrivial unbranched donor–bridge–acceptor chain. The claimed quantity is its experimentally meaningful first-absorption time and the question of a real positive optimal environment noise rate. The exact sharp cubic onset, unique-global-optimum proof for an entire two-parameter family, and large-gradient scale distinguish when dephasing genuinely enhances transport while excluding twin peaks in a natural minimal topology. This is not merely evaluating a known plot point, a parameter substitution, or a routine bound: it supplies a global mechanism-level classification absent from the inspected primary discussion.
